description: HesabYar Phase 2 (per design-eng.md §17): accounting workflows. Extend the port + Tryton adapter with post/reverse/journal-read and fiscal-year/period reads; journal draft services + REST endpoints with validation, posting, reversal, idempotency and audit; fiscal-year/period + company/chart setup-status views; invoice/payment/statement adapter + services + endpoints. Builds on branch ralph/phase-1 (FastAPI platform, auth, migrations). Spec: ~/workspace/user/files/design-eng_0_zaup.md (§8, §9.2, §10, §14). Exit criteria: users can execute the core accounting workflows through the new API, with Tryton as the only posting authority.

acceptanceCriteria: AccountingEnginePort extended with post_journal, reverse_journal, get_journal (read a posted move), list_fiscal_years, list_periods — engine-neutral types only, no Tryton imports in domain
TrytonAccountingAdapter implements all five via the REST API only (no SQL against Tryton's DB; no JSON-RPC for model data)

Contract tests against live Tryton 8.2.3: post a balanced draft → posted move with Tryton reference; reverse it → reversal move linked to the original; posted move has no edit/delete path through the adapter
Journal invariants enforced per design-eng §8.2: balanced totals, valid accounts, open period, atomic posting; unbalanced/unknown-account/closed-period post attempts are rejected with stable errors
Ruff, Pyright and the full test suite pass
userStories.description: As the platform I want the adapter to post, reverse and read journals plus fiscal years and periods, so workflows can run entirely through the engine port.
userStories.notes: Coordinator-verified 2026-11-16: commit 0f1da64; ruff pass, pyright 0 errors, full suite 439 passed (fresh, by coordinator); port has all 5 methods; adapter REST-only (grep clean), domain import-clean. Reversal is NOT atomic (create+post, 2 REST calls; failed post surfaces reversal_draft_id); reversal does NOT reconcile reconcile-account lines; closed-account/closed-period post rejections are unit-tested only (engine makes those states unreachable via REST — verified live). Period.reopen quirk fixed in test cleanup (journal-periods must be reopened too).
userStories.title: Adapter: post/reverse/journal-read + fiscal years/periods

acceptanceCriteria: Application services for journal drafts (create/update/get/list, validate, post, reverse) call ONLY the engine port; REST routes contain no accounting rules

Endpoints live per design-eng §9.2: POST/GET/PATCH /api/v1/accounting/journal-drafts, POST .../validate, POST .../post, POST /api/v1/accounting/journals/{journal_id}/reverse — behind scopes ledger:draft:create, ledger:draft:update, ledger:post, ledger:reverse
Idempotency-Key enforced on post (and draft create): same key + same payload hash → same result, no duplicate posting; same key + different payload → 409 conflict (design-eng §10.4)
Every post/reverse writes an audit event (actor, operation, company, Tryton reference, idempotency key, UTC timestamp) to audit_events
End-to-end tests with a real issued key + live Tryton: draft → validate → post → reverse, with the posted move visible in Tryton and the reversal linked
Ruff, Pyright and the full test suite pass
userStories.description: As an accountant I want to draft, validate, post and reverse journals through the API, so daily bookkeeping runs on HesabYar with Tryton as the only posting authority.
userStories.notes: PASS after follow-up. Core commit 864868f (services + 7 endpoints + idempotency + audit) verified by coordinator in an isolated worktree (63/63 tests). Gap closed by follow-up commit c506aaf: list_journal_drafts + update_journal_draft + get_journal_draft on the port, REST-only adapter (single atomic PUT for update), JournalEngine protocol collapsed into AccountingEnginePort. Coordinator re-verified the follow-up in an isolated worktree at 19f9d1e (scratch DB): ruff pass, pyright 0 errors, full suite 668 passed. Known limit: PATCH requires Idempotency-Key but does not claim it for replay and writes no audit event yet (re-execution is naturally idempotent); recorded as a Deferred item.
userStories.title: Journal draft services + endpoints (validate/post/reverse, idempotent, audited)

acceptanceCriteria: Application services + REST endpoints for fiscal years and periods (list/get, open/closed state, company-scoped) behind ledger:read
Company/chart setup-status endpoints: whether the company has a chart installed, which template, fiscal year present — read-only setup state for the future dashboard wizard

Research spike documented in docs/setup-wizard.md: can company creation + chart installation be driven through Tryton REST (actions/wizards), or does it need a small versioned custom Tryton module? Go/no-go with the concrete approach for the dashboard wizard — no guessing, verified against docs and the live server
Ruff, Pyright and the full test suite pass

userStories.notes: Coordinator-verified 2026-11-16: commit b7c8175; ruff pass, pyright 0 errors, all 57 US-203 tests pass (fresh, by coordinator). 5 endpoints (fiscal years/periods list/get + setup-status) behind ledger:read; spike verdict NO-GO for pure REST chart install, GO for a small versioned custom Tryton module (docs/setup-wizard.md, verified live incl. 135-account install in a scratch DB).
